sourceRequirements.namedStructure: Preserve all five separately named transverse short freight drums, broad freight base, high forward command beam, both bounded closed drive casings and pressure canopy in selected own native source. Exact full source parts, not bbox/count replacement.
sourceRequirements.glazingSupport: Source-derived opaque deck and four base connections, lower canopy pressure foundation and two trim housing base posts must satisfy independent source reconstruction and real fixed-view review. Source equations/contact occupancy alone do not establish visibility/R3 acceptance.
sourceRequirements.gaps: Preserve actual original-source openings/empty corridors; do not infer a gap merely because components are separately named. Native bounded closed drive casing is not a promised hollow throat. Global gap/support ray outcomes remain unissued.
sourceRequirements.detailedContext: Full detailed source supplies original cockpit brace/service pipe/inset/emitter intent. Preserve its exact source data; it does not issue a new continuous/nativeLOD tolerance or require invented native topology.
sourceRequirements.appearance: Exact original palette sand-maroon, material RGBA/emissive values, MIT/source fields, textures/repeat/faceUV/material assignment. Source exactness includes all appearance fields; no lost glazing, filled source opening or new arbitrary texture-coordinate patch.
sourceRequirements.topology: Exact original native component/vertex/face order and connectivity; finite/index/nondegenerate/oriented closure per authored component; preserve intentional independently closed/overlapping components, no forced single welded hull. Model/physical JSON remain opaque during this authoring step.
sourceRequirements.sourceDeviationAllowance: Only declared new opaque deck/four base posts/two housing posts and exact detailed brace/two housing transplants, plus lower canopy material/UV replacement. Original native vertices/faces and every unaffected field remain exact. New source-derived coordinates allow <=1e-10 metre serialization/IEEE arithmetic discrepancy, not a shape/clearance/physics deviation. All topology/material/UV/source metadata exact. No historical support claim or physical authority.

cameraRule.basis: look toward authored origin from frozen eyeAxis; up vector as listed; no camera roll or orbit
cameraRule.frameReference: use ONLY literal original-native header fullDetailPhysicalBounds min[-16.5,-6.248,-28.09],max[16.5,14.04,21.0], as framing metadata, not a measured collision/clearance result
cameraRule.construction: G1 later constructs six view bases from fixed axis/up. With focal=1024px, usableHalf=448px and nearMargin=1 source metre, set D=max over declared-header box corners of (dot(corner,eyeAxis)+focal*max(abs(dot(corner,right)),abs(dot(corner,up)))/usableHalf)+nearMargin. No value evaluated here. Eye=D*eyeAxis; center=(512,512); positive forward depth is D-dot(point,eyeAxis). Far=D+max(abs(dot(headercorner,eyeAxis)))+nearMargin.
cameraRule.freeze: Derive six cameras ONCE from literal original header in independent reference stage, freeze them with expected table before SUT. Identical cameras for original/current rendering. Scale0.2 renders DEFERRED to separate real-role phase, no normalisation/reframe/extra camera calls.

renderComparison.originalVsCurrent: Require canonical source/native/material/UV exactness before draw and deterministic same-view/same-style production render comparison; exact pixel/line equality is proposed for unchanged original/current source only, no post-run threshold tuning.
renderComparison.scaledProduct: No scale0.2 render in this phase; full original/current6views x3styles=36 restored. Scale0.2 collision remains nonactor source check; actual role render/admission separateblocked.
renderComparison.visualReview: All named source structure/glazing/opaque support/gaps/materials remain owner review obligations at fixed views. localTriangleControlBasis.authority: Independent analytic closed-triangle point and finite-radius edge/corner controls, original-reference geometry only; no production-kernel-derived expected results.
localTriangleControlBasis.reference: G1 later authenticates13ef reference independently and builds reference Face(a,b,c) records, distinct from original/current queried product objects. Construct points/normals ONLY from reference, never queried candidate or collision outcome.
localTriangleControlBasis.formula: Original face q uses frozen barycentric tuple, n=unit((b-a)cross(c-a)); origin=q+n, direction=-n, range=2. Interior/outside have radius0. Edge/corner radius=min(1/8,minimum-altitude/16) source metres; scale points/origin/range/radius by0.2 for scaled product. Formula inputs from independent original only, never candidate/contact. Quantize frozen ray toIEEE doubles FIRST; reference predicate uses exact binary values.
localTriangleControlBasis.expected: Interior/edge/corner HIT, outside MISS on isolated triangle. Expected distances and whole-hull nearest ties computed only by independent original-reference phase and frozen before production. Finite-radius edge/corner first contact is separately checked with dimensionless closed-form analytic controls. No global gap/opacity/admission claim.
localTriangleControlBasis.proposedNumericalTestTolerance: NEW ENGINEERING: comparison distance/tie tolerance=1e-8 metres +1e-10*ray.range, frozen for all products; not source-deviation or clearance allowance. Decimal80 reference,128+128 fixed convex-root iterations; ambiguous tangency at1e-32*max(1,radius^2,range^2) squared-distance fails. Point coplanarity/containment thresholds1e-40/1e-30 fixed in reference code. No tuning from SUT.

Owner must identify actual opaque support surfaces/interfaces independently.

engineering.referenceMethod: Independent original TOML parse_float=Decimal loader and ownvector math only. Point rays: plane plus affine barycentric interval clipping. Swept sphere: convex point-to-triangle projection via feasible plane QP/threeclampedsegments; monotone squared-distance derivative bisection then first-radius-crossing bisection. This is fixed root solving for predetermined witnesses, not exploratory ray search. Production kernel/renderer/candidate cannot generate expectations.

engineering.axisWitnessConstruction: Centre=(headerMin+headerMax)/2; diagonal=norm(headerMax-headerMin); origin=centre+axis*2diagonal; dir=-axis; range4diagonal; radius0. Six fixed source axes, no search.
engineering.relationWitnessConstruction: Midpoint of two frozen original selector face centroids; +X axis for DRIVE_* relations, +Y otherwise; origin=midpoint+axis*2diagonal; dir=-axis; range4diagonal; radius=diagonal/10000. Scale all lengths/points for0.2 product. No promise of hit/miss/emptygap from relationname.
